{
  "name": "hudcade",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "daniel"
  },
  "description": "A pixel-art HUD for Claude Code: context, cost, cache, agents and rate limits at a glance, little 8-bit scenes while Claude thinks, and Telegram notifications.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "hud": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "HUD band",
      "description": "Show model, effort, cost, context, rate limits, git and session/agent progress above the prompt.",
      "default": true
    },
    "statusLine": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Status line",
      "description": "Show a compact line under the prompt: model, effort, context, cost and 5-hour/7-day usage.",
      "default": true
    },
    "spinner": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pixel spinner",
      "description": "Replace the working spinner with a little 8-bit scene that reacts to what Claude is doing (terminal only).",
      "default": true
    },
    "spinnerScene": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Spinner scene",
      "description": "Which scene the spinner plays; random picks a different one each turn.",
      "options": [
        "random",
        "robot",
        "coffee",
        "garden",
        "rocket",
        "cat",
        "fishing",
        "train",
        "campfire",
        "weather",
        "equalizer"
      ],
      "default": "random"
    },
    "ctxWarnPercent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Context warning %",
      "description": "Context usage at which the HUD turns yellow and shows a toast.",
      "default": 60
    },
    "ctxCriticalPercent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Context critical %",
      "description": "Context usage at which the HUD turns red and shows a toast.",
      "default": 80
    },
    "notify": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Telegram notifications",
      "description": "Send Telegram messages when a turn completes, needs your approval, or fails.",
      "default": true
    },
    "notifyMinTurnSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Notify: minimum turn seconds",
      "description": "Skip completion messages for turns shorter than this; 0 sends every turn.",
      "default": 0
    },
    "notifyBlocklist": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Notify: blocked projects",
      "description": "Space-separated project folder names that never notify.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "notifyLanguage": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Notify: language",
      "description": "Language of the Telegram messages; auto follows Claude Code's language setting (Chinese there means Traditional Chinese, anything else English).",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "zh-TW"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "telegramBotToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Telegram bot token",
      "description": "Bot token from @BotFather. When unset, ~/.claude/hooks/.telegram.env is read instead.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    },
    "telegramChatId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Telegram chat id",
      "description": "Chat that receives the messages. When unset, ~/.claude/hooks/.telegram.env is read instead.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    }
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/g761007/hudcade",
  "repository": "https://github.com/g761007/hudcade",
  "keywords": [
    "hud",
    "statusline",
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "pixel-art",
    "spinner",
    "telegram"
  ]
}
files.types/index.d.ts:
export type SceneName =
  | 'robot'
  | 'coffee'
  | 'garden'
  | 'rocket'
  | 'cat'
  | 'fishing'
  | 'train'
  | 'campfire'
  | 'weather'
  | 'equalizer'

export type GitInfo = {
  branch: string
  isDirty: boolean
  ahead: number
  behind: number
}

export type RateWindow = {
  kind: string
  percent: number
  resetsAt?: string
}

export type ToolRun = {
  id: string
  tool: string
  detail: string
  startedAt: number
  agentId?: string
}

export type AgentRun = {
  key: string
  toolUseId?: string
  agentId?: string
  type: string
  description: string
  model?: string
  isBackground: boolean
  startedAt: number
  endedAt?: number
  tools: number
  currentTool?: string
  status: 'running' | 'done' | 'failed'
}

export type TaskItem = {
  id?: string
  subject: string
  status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed'
}

export type CacheStats = {
  read: number
  written: number
  uncached: number
  requests: number
  lastHitPercent?: number
  isCold?: boolean
  rebuildUsd?: number
  ttl?: '5m' | '1h'
}

export type TurnTokens = { input: number; output: number }

export type BackgroundTask = { id: string; type: string; status: string; description: string }

export type Cron = { id: string; schedule: string; isRecurring: boolean; prompt: string }

export type Teammate = { id: string; name: string; status: string; description: string }

export type CtxSlice = { name: string; tokens: number }

export type DiffStats = { added: number; removed: number; files: string[] }

export type TurnState = {
  count: number
  status: 'idle' | 'working' | 'waiting'
  startedAt?: number
  endedAt?: number
  lastDurationMs?: number
  costAtStart?: number
}

export type Hud = {
  model?: string
  effort?: string
  project: string
  sessionTitle?: string
  git?: GitInfo
  sessionStartedAt?: number
  tzOffsetMinutes?: number
  ctx?: { tokens?: number; window: number; percent?: number }
  costUsd?: number
  rates: RateWindow[]
  turn: TurnState
  tools: { total: number; failed: number; running: ToolRun[] }
  agents: AgentRun[]
  tasks: TaskItem[]
  cache?: CacheStats
  turnTokens?: TurnTokens
  tokensPerSecond?: number
  compactions: number
  diff: DiffStats
  background: BackgroundTask[]
  crons: Cron[]
  teammates: Teammate[]
  ctxTop?: CtxSlice[]
}

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'hudcade': { hud: Hud }
  }
}
